name: Dungeons & Dragons Online: The Soul Splitter
storyline: The player gets pulled into an investigation about Warforged disappearing in Sharn. They start off by searching for Dorris, an old friend and lieutenant of the Lord of Blades, who has vanished while on a mission from her superior. It turns out that people have been using a modified version of Vaunt’s device to rip the souls out of Warforged and turn them into compliant creatures devoid of free will. The Lord of Blades commands the player to figure out who is behind the ‘soul splitters’ and fix the problem … or he’ll take his army to Sharn.
summary: This adventure pack contains six dungeons for high level characters. Explore previously unseen parts of Sharn as you search for an old acquaintance. Uncover a vile conspiracy that seeks to enslave the city’s Warforged, visit Sharn's most luxurious private clubs, and discover the shocking surprise lurking in a mad wizard’s hidden base.
